description: This file defines classes and functions for generating and handling FunctionSchema objects for higher-order operators in PyTorch, including schema generation from example values, argument info, and schema inference from FX graph nodes.

classes.name: HopArgumentInfo
classes.description: Data class representing information about a hop argument, including name, example value, default value, mutation status, and kw_only flag.

classes.name: HopArgumentInfoGen
classes.description: Utility class with static method to generate HopArgumentInfo from example values.

classes.name: CTypeGen
classes.description: Class providing static methods to infer types from example values, mapping Python types to Torch types.

classes.name: CArgumentGen
classes.description: Class with static method to generate torch._C.Argument objects from HopArgumentInfo.

classes.name: HopSchemaGenerator
classes.description: Class to build a schema for a HigherOrderOperator, including adding arguments, outputs, and generating the FunctionSchema.

classes.name: CFunctionSchemaGen
classes.description: Class with static method to generate a FunctionSchema from argument info and output info, enforcing invariants for higher-order operator schemas.

classes.name: HopSchema
classes.description: Subclass of torch._C.FunctionSchema that includes additional schema tree specification and supports deep copying.

methods.name: from_example
methods.description: Creates a HopArgumentInfo instance from an example value with optional name, default, mutation, and kw_only flags.

methods.name: from_hop_argument_info
methods.description: Generates a torch._C.Argument object from HopArgumentInfo, considering if it is an output argument.

methods.name: add_arg
methods.description: Adds an argument to the HopSchemaGenerator, validating that the example value is a leaf node in the pytree.

methods.name: add_output
methods.description: Adds an output value to the schema generator.

methods.name: add_schema_tree_spec
methods.description: Stores the tree structure of the flattened inputs to reconstruct the original pytree structure.

methods.name: gen_schema
methods.description: Generates a FunctionSchema object based on the accumulated argument info and outputs.

methods.name: from_hop_argument_info
methods.description: Creates a FunctionSchema for a higher-order operator from argument info and output info, enforcing schema invariants.
